text: Hana's housewarming is Saturday at 7pm. She said not to bring wine because Kiri has already stocked up, so maybe flowers or a plant for the new balcony. Kiri also said Hana has been stressed about the place not being finished, the kitchen is still half painted, so I said I'd come over early on Saturday at 4 to help set up.

Graham called. His dad was admitted to hospital last night with a chest infection. He sounded exhausted. Need to check in with him on Thursday. He's also juggling the kids on his own because his wife is away for work until the 18th, and he doesn't want to tell his boss how bad it is. I might offer to do the school run on Wednesday morning.
Laura's birthday is March 9th. She's really into pottery at the moment and keeps mentioning a wheel class in town.
Blessing invited us to dinner on the 14th at half 7. Her husband Chidi is cooking jollof, apparently his signature dish.
Arjun mentioned his daughter has chickenpox, so the playdate on Wednesday is off.
Drop off the dry cleaning and pick up a birthday card on the way home.

Fiona Reyes, Fi to everyone at work, is turning 40 on November 2nd. Her partner is planning a surprise party at the Crown that evening at 8. Don't forget to chip in for the group present before Friday.
Ines broke her wrist skiing. Cast for six weeks, and she's annoyed because it's her right hand. She starts physio on 12/3.
Rahul's engagement party has been cancelled. He and his fiancée split up last week and he's taking it hard. I should take him out for a pint soon.
Kevin is vegan and doesn't drink, worth remembering for the barbecue.

Lunch with Nikolai. He's obsessed with vinyl again and has been hunting for an original pressing of Kind of Blue. Perfect birthday idea if I ever spot one. His birthday is September 9th. He also said he's been getting into making his own hot sauce and has a shelf of chillies growing on the windowsill, which explains the state of his kitchen.
Mandla's mum has her knee replacement on January 8th at 9am. He's driving up the night before to be with her. Remind me to text him that afternoon to see how it went.
Kiri and Tunde are hosting a games night next Friday at 8. I'm bringing dessert.
Ask Matteo how his son's tonsil operation went.
Tiago said his dog Biscuit has to have a lump removed on the 21st. He's pretty worried about it.
Svetlana is doing a Ukrainian supper club on April 5th and asked if I'd come. Said yes. She's nervous because it's her first time cooking for strangers.
Tendai's little girl turns five on June 3rd. She is mad about dinosaurs, especially anything with a T-rex on it.
Farid had his appendix out on Monday. Home now, but he can't lift anything for a month. His wife Nia is off work looking after him.
Mental note: Elijah loves craft beer and hates anything with coriander.

Aaliyah messaged to say the christening is on May 18th at 11am, with lunch afterwards at her parents' place. Need to RSVP by the end of the week and find out what a sensible gift is. Her mother-in-law is apparently very traditional, so something silver might be the safe option. Aaliyah also mentioned the baby has finally started sleeping through, so she's feeling much more human.
Eamon's back is playing up again, so he's missing five-a-side for a while.
Varun is throwing a leaving do on Thursday at 6, drinks at the Fox before he moves to Leeds on the 30th.

Coffee with Manon. Her dad has been diagnosed with Parkinson's and she's trying to work out how often she can get down to Bordeaux. She seemed really low. I must keep in touch more over the next few weeks, maybe a call on Sunday evening.
Duc's birthday drinks: October 28th, 7:30, the rooftop bar near his office. He hinted that he'd love some new running headphones.
Wei said her mum is coming over from Shanghai for a month on 11/15. They're planning a big family dinner the first weekend.
Sean's daughter Molly was in A&E overnight with a bad asthma attack. She's fine now but they're keeping her off school until Monday.
Reggie turned 60 yesterday. Totally forgot. Send him a belated card and something nice, he loves gardening.
Uma's having people round for Diwali on November 8th from 6pm. Bring sweets, not alcohol.
Book the car in for its MOT and sort out the gas bill.
Graham and his wife are celebrating their silver wedding anniversary on July 19th with a garden party. We're invited, so I'll need to book the Friday off.
Hana mentioned her brother Kevin is in hospital after a cycling accident. Broken collarbone, a few stitches. She's visiting him tomorrow morning.
Laura has been feeling rubbish all week, some kind of flu. She cancelled her own birthday dinner, which was meant to be Saturday. Need to drop some soup round to her.
Blessing's son Tunde starts secondary school in September and he's nervous about the bus.
Arjun Kumar, my old flatmate, is back in town for one night on 9/22. Dinner at the Thai place at 7?
Fiona told me her mum is having a scan on Tuesday morning. She doesn't want a fuss but I should text her on Tuesday night.
Interesting chat with Ines at the party. She's training for her first triathlon and has got really into open-water swimming.
Rahul's mum's 70th is on August 12th. He's organising a surprise lunch and asked if I can help with decorations.
Kevin's cat Pepper went missing on Sunday. He's put posters up everywhere. Keep an eye out on the way to work.

Nikolai and Svetlana are hosting Christmas Eve dinner this year, December 24th at 5pm. They asked everyone to bring one dish. I'm doing roast potatoes. Svetlana is also doing a little Secret Santa with a ten pound limit, names drawn on December 1st. Nikolai keeps joking that he wants socks.
Mandla said the operation went well and his mum is already walking with a frame. Relief all round.
Kiri hates surprises, so no surprise party for her birthday on February 2nd. She'd prefer a quiet dinner and has been eyeing up a cookbook by Ottolenghi.
Note to self: Tunde's partner is allergic to nuts.
Matteo's brother Luca is getting married in Tuscany on June 7th. Matteo is best man and is terrified about the speech. Wish him luck that morning.
Tiago got invited to his boss's barbecue on Saturday afternoon and has no idea what to bring. Told him beer is always safe.

Tendai's dad is unwell again. Kidney problems, and he's back on dialysis three times a week. Tendai is flying out to Harare on the 3rd at 6am and doesn't know how long he'll stay. I should call him before he goes and offer to water his plants while he's away. He also mentioned money is tight with the flights, so maybe don't suggest anything expensive.
Farid and Nia's housewarming was great. Remember to ask Farid how the move-in inspection went on Friday.

Elijah is starting his new job at the hospital on Monday at 8am. Big change for him after ten years in retail. He's excited but a bit nervous about the night shifts, and his partner Uma is worried he'll burn out. Remind me to text him Monday evening to ask how the first day went.
Aaliyah's twins turn three on April 14th. One wants a scooter, the other wants anything pink, according to her.
Eamon Baker from the choir, Big E, is recovering from a mild stroke. Visiting hours are 2 to 4. Don't forget to bring him the crossword book.
Varun's wife Priya is due on December 1st. He's already panicking about the car seat.
Manon's daughter has glandular fever and will miss her exams next week. Manon is stressed about it.

Long call with Duc. He's been having panic attacks since the redundancy and hasn't been sleeping. He has a doctor's appointment on Thursday at 10:15. His sister Wei is coming to stay with him this weekend, which should help. I need to check in on Friday morning and see if he wants to grab breakfast.
Wei loves bubble tea and anything matcha flavoured. Good to know for her birthday in March.
Sean invited me to his band's gig at the Brewhouse on the 16th at 9pm. His first one in years.
Reggie's granddaughter graduated from nursing school on May 22nd. He was beaming.
Uma's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is next Wednesday at 1pm. Send flowers to Uma and her mum.
Dinner at Graham's tonight was lovely. His son Elijah is home from uni and is thinking about switching to medicine. Graham's wife mentioned she'd like a new bread maker for her birthday on 10/30.
Picked up the cake for Saturday. Still need candles and balloons.
Hana's cat Miso has been off her food since Thursday and has a vet appointment Monday at 4:30. Hana is really anxious.

Laura and Kiri are both coming to my birthday dinner on January 17th. Laura said she's bringing her new boyfriend, Reggie Osei, whom nobody has met. Kiri is gluten free, so I need to check the menu at the restaurant before then, and book a table for six by the 10th at the latest. Also remember Laura's knee is still bad from the fall, so somewhere without stairs.
